top_signals.title: Apollo's Slok Says Warsh Silence Fuels Treasury Selloff
top_signals.summary: Federal Reserve Chairman Kevin Warsh's decision to abandon forward guidance on monetary policy is driving bond market volatility, with 30-year Treasuries selling off after Wednesday's rate decision, according to Torsten Slok, chief economist at Apollo Global Management. He speaks on Bloomberg Television's "The Fed Decides." (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Apollo’s Slok Says Fed’s New Silence Fuels ‘Yo-Yo’ Bond Market
top_signals.summary: Apollo Global Management’s Torsten Slok said the Federal Reserve’s abandonment of forward guidance is fueling historic bond market volatility, sending Treasury yields swinging “up and down like a yo-yo.”
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.summary: Thoma Bravo’s Proofpoint Inc. has reworked a $5 billion loan deal, offering major concessions to lenders increasingly anxious about AI-driven tech disruption.
